issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按卡片猜成 30f，只渲出第一个词，后两拍和收尾全丢
左上角打着调试标题 "CEL FLASH STOMP"
大词只有 210px Helvetica，远没"砸满屏"；砸落 4f 只是平面缩放，没有高度与冲击感
底部标签条是三根灰色骨架条
底闪两色纯平铺，画面没有任何空气感
changes: 补 CEL_FLASH_STOMP_DURATION = 144（3 词 × 30f + 末词 64f 静止），三拍节奏与 2f 底闪参数原样保留
去掉调试标题；词放大到 340px、系统 Display 字栈 900 字重、-0.045em 字距
砸落 0–4f 加"高度"：随离地高度变化的投影（远而虚→贴实）+ 两层 1.1×/1.22× 淡残影收拢做冲击模糊 + 歪角从 1.6× 砸正，落地后完全锐利静止
标签条换成出版级内容：靛蓝品牌标 + "Release 4.2 / Available now for every team" + 等宽域名，32px 达标字高，14f 淡入并上移 24px
底闪两色各加极弱中心亮径向（仍是无物的空气），整段一张静态颗粒压色带，不引入逐帧噪声
issuesEn: No exported duration constant, so the workbench guessed 30f from the card and only the first word rendered — the other two beats and the tail were missing
A debug title "CEL FLASH STOMP" sat in the top-left corner
Words were only 210px Helvetica, nowhere near filling the frame; the 4f stomp was a flat scale with no height or impact
The bottom label bar was three gray skeleton bars
Both flash colors were flat fills with no sense of air
changesEn: Added CEL_FLASH_STOMP_DURATION = 144 (3 words × 30f + 64f final hold); beat timing and the 2f background flash kept exactly
Removed the debug title; words enlarged to 340px, system Display stack at 900 weight, -0.045em tracking

Gave the 0–4f stomp height: a height-dependent shadow (far and soft → tight contact), two 1.1×/1.22× faint echoes collapsing as impact blur, and the tilt slamming from 1.6× to 1×; fully sharp and still after landing
Label bar now carries publication-grade content — indigo brand mark, "Release 4.2 / Available now for every team" and a monospace domain — at 32px, fading in over 14f with a 24px rise
Each flash color gets a very faint center-bright radial (still empty air), plus one static grain texture for the whole shot to kill banding without adding per-frame noise
